purpose: Audit exactly one authenticated ocean-sensor observable after v54-v57 without inferring raw CTD response physics from processed salinity.

single_mechanism.name: causal conductivity-cell thermal-inertia mismatch residual
single_mechanism.scientific_fingerprint: Use synchronized raw temperature and conductivity channels plus authenticated cell-flow and response parameters to predict the conductivity-cell wall thermal anomaly; its causal correction residual is a sensor-state observable on anchor-negative rows.

primary_source.title: Thermal Inertia of Conductivity Cells: Theory
primary_source.author: Rolf G. Lueck
primary_source.venue: Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology 7(5), 741-755
primary_source.claim_boundary: The paper models temperature anomalies induced by heat stored in conductivity-cell walls under stated flow and heat-transfer assumptions. It does not establish P1 instrument type, raw-channel availability, response parameters, anomaly benefit, or competition performance.

schema_support_audit.available_salinity_representation: processed practical salinity, not raw conductivity
required_but_absent: raw thermistor channel with authenticated sensor-to-cell time alignment
pressure channel and conductivity-to-salinity processing provenance
conductivity-cell geometry/material and thermal response coefficient
pump or free-stream flow rate through the cell
instrument model, firmware, and prior thermal-lag correction status
schema_support_audit.reason: Processed salinity can already contain proprietary or upstream temperature, pressure, calibration, and thermal-lag corrections. The original cell-wall anomaly and response state cannot be recovered uniquely from temp, psal, and depth.

temperature_salinity_matched_filter.overlap: Existing P1 logic compares temperature interval boundaries and drift with same-boundary processed-salinity changes. A lagged temp-psal proxy would reuse these channels and action geometry without recovering cell physics.

causal_path_crossmoment.overlap: v7 already executed continuous ordered temp-psal signed path area and multiscale increments. A processed-channel phase or hysteresis summary is reconstructible from that closed family.

base_temporal_features.overlap: Base features already expose raw/missing/difference/rolling temp and psal information to supervised models.

physical_consistency_closure.overlap: v21 closed deterministic temp-psal-depth consistency transforms because they introduce no new observed or intervention layer.

decision.reason: The exact thermal-inertia observable is scientifically distinct but cannot be computed from processed salinity without raw conductivity, time-alignment, cell, flow, and correction provenance. Any processed temp-psal surrogate repeats closed features.
decision.minimum_new_evidence: Competition-allowed synchronized raw conductivity, thermistor temperature and pressure; stable instrument identity; cell geometry/material, flow, sampling alignment, calibration, and prior-correction provenance across train and deployment.
